messages:
selena: heads-up — deploybot skipped a publish for notifications:v4.0.5. flagged as ambiguous registry prefix (root vs apac). automatic promote blocked.

deploybot: publish skipped for image `notifications:v4.0.5`
reason: tag exists in multiple repo prefixes: `registry.redwood.io/notifications` and `registry.redwood.io/apac/notifications`. refusing automatic promote to avoid serving unintended manifest.

ogden: staging needs this for the scheduled canary tonight. can we manual-promote?

mike: yes — manual promote by digest is the safe path. copy canonical digest into a staging-qualified repo and pin deploybot to that digest. avoid reusing the ambiguous short tag.

selena: which registry is canonical for this build?

ogden: root is canonical; the apac mirror was created for latency tests and got the same tag. root digest is sha256:beefcafedeadbeef1234... (truncated).

mike: proposed commands (verify creds & digests before running):
```
# copy exact digest to a staging-qualified repo
skopeo copy \
  docker://registry.redwood.io/notifications@sha256:beefcafedeadbeef1234 \
  docker://registry.redwood.io/staging/notifications:promote-1823456789 --preserve-digests
# pin deploybot to the digest
deploybot set-pin --service=notifications --env=staging --image=registry.redwood.io/staging/notifications@sha256:beefcafedeadbeef1234
```

release-cd: also run `cosign verify` on the staging digest if attestations exist, and include a smoke healthcheck before releasing traffic.

ops: change window suggestion: 19:30 UTC for 30 minutes. rollback criteria: revert if error rate >3% or p95 latency increases >200ms within first 10 minutes.

selena: i'll open a PR with the skopeo step, cosign verify, deploy pin, and a one-button revert script; will tag @mike @ogden @ops.

deploybot: note: automatic retries remain disabled for ambiguous-prefix events. manual operator confirmation required for promote.

mike: filing a quick lint ticket to block identical unqualified tags across multiple prefixes so deploybot can surface this earlier.

ogden: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/release/pull/1600 — includes promote-by-digest, cosign verify, healthcheck, and revert. tagging @selena @mike @ops

selena: thanks — will run the promote during the window and paste logs here.
